biggest_catch: You earn whatever each individual researcher sets — CloudResearch only enforces a $6/hour floor and reports ~$10/hour averages; there is no guarantee of how many studies you will be offered or qualify for.
catches: Zero guaranteed studies — each study is researcher-posted, limited in size, and fills up fast.
Screening and qualification: researchers can screen, terminate, or reject submissions per study.
Pay varies study to study — the $10/hour average is a norm, not a promise; the only hard floor is $6/hour.
Variable availability: study flow depends on researcher demand, not on your schedule.
Payout method varies per study (PayPal, bank transfers, or Amazon gift cards — researcher-dependent).
Unpaid screeners are possible; some studies compensate only partially for screen-outs.
Participants are restricted to the U.S. and must be at least 18 years old per the official white paper.
Effective hourly pay can land near the $6 floor on lower-paying studies.

steps: Sign up as a Connect participant on the CloudResearch Connect platform.
Complete your participant profile so studies can be matched to you.
Receive email and/or text notifications when new studies launch, or browse your participant dashboard.
Preview each study (pay, length, requirements) and choose whether to participate.
Complete the study via the researcher's survey tool (e.g., Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, Google Forms).
Get your submission approved by the researcher and receive payment per the study's stated terms.
